 We believe in a
 **people\-first culture** 
 , where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Ready to make your mark?
 **Join us and be part of something bigger.**
**Job Profile Description**
 Kainos is recognised as one of the UK’s leading AI and data businesses, with a decade\-long track record of delivering impactful, production\-grade AI solutions for clients across government, healthcare, defence, and commercial sectors. Kainos is at the forefront of AI innovation, trusted by Microsoft, AWS, and others to deliver advanced AI and data solutions at citizen scale.
   

  

 Our 150\-strong AI and Data Practice brings together deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI and data. We are pioneers in responsible AI, having authored the UK government’s AI Cyber Security Code of Practice implementation guide and we partner with leading organisations to ensure AI is deployed ethically, securely and with measurable business value. Our teams are at the cutting edge of AI research, and delivery, it is truly an exciting team to join Kainos as we further grow our AI capability.
   

  

**M** 
**AIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE** 
**\&** 
**RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS** 
**:**
 As a Senior AI Engineer at Kainos, you will deliver advanced AI solutions leveraging state\-of\-the\-art machine learning, generative and agentic AI technologies. You will drive the adoption of modern AI frameworks, AIOps best practices and scalable cloud\-native architectures. Your role will involve hands\-on technical delivery, collaborating with customers to translate business challenges into trustworthy AI solutions and ensuring responsible AI practices throughout. As a technical mentor, you will foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
   

  

 It is a fast\-paced environment, so it is important for you to make sound, reasoned decisions. You will do this whilst learning about new technologies and approaches, with talented colleagues that will help you to develop and grow. You will support your colleagues and more junior developers, providing direction support as you solve challenging problems together.
   

  

**Minimum (essential) Requirements**
* A minimum of a 2\.1 degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Statistics or in a similar quantitative field.
* Demonstrable experience of deploying modern AI/ML solutions into production, including prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), model evaluation, and monitoring using metrics (e.g. precision, recall, NDCG and drift detection).
* Strong Python skills with a grounding in software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, code reviews etc).
* Experience developing solutions at scale on cloud platforms (Azure \& AWS), containerisation and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Expertise in data engineering for AI: handling large\-scale, unstructured, and multimodal data.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles, model interpretability, and ethical considerations.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team working.


**Desirable**
* Demonstrable experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow), fine\-tuning or distillation of LLMs (e.g., GPT, Llama, Claude, Gemini), machine learning libraries (e.g. scikit\-learn, XGBoost).
* Experience with data storage for AI, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge graphs.
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects or research publications.
* Familiarity with AI security, privacy, and compliance standards e.g. ISO42001\.


**Embracing our differences**
 At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.
   

  

 Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.
   

  

 We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

 Your mission is to help turn Fin's entire R\&D organization into an AI\-first engineering machine. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer \| Devoli \| Auckland (Hybrid)** 




  





 Devoli is not your typical tech business. It started as a telco, grew into one of New Zealand's most consistently high\-growth companies, and is now in the middle of something genuinely interesting: transforming into a software platform business, using the revenue and stability it has already built to fund an ambitious technical future.
 



  





 The software team is not maintaining a product on the side. They are building the platform that will eventually become the entire business.
 



  





**What you will bring** 



* Experience with at least part of the stack: Python, TypeScript, Go, Next.js, AWS, Postgres, MongoDB
* Solid grasp of software architecture and design, including object orientation, event\-driven architecture, and distributed service design
* Experience working within and helping define distributed architectures where boundaries are still being established
* AWS production experience, including owning and running what you build
* Background in a B2B software product organisation, not just internal development
* Genuine engagement with agentic AI tooling beyond basic code generation, someone who thinks about agents, context, workflows, and parallelism and has found ways to put that into practice



  





**What you will be working on** 




 The platform spans several large and genuinely complex domains: CPQ and pricing systems, end\-user billing and subscription management, a new authentication and authorisation framework, a redesigned customer portal, and a distributed service architecture being actively built out from a legacy PHP monolith.
 



  





 The go\-forward stack is Go and Python on the backend, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, with AWS, Postgres, and MongoDB rounding things out. The architecture direction is distributed and service\-oriented, with bounded contexts being defined as the platform grows. You will not be handed a map. You will help draw it.
 



  





 On top of the core platform work, the team is actively investing in how agentic AI changes the way software is built, at both an individual and team level. Some engineers are already orchestrating small teams of agents to multiply their output. Others are finding their rhythm. The goal is to keep pushing that capability further across the entire development process, and new engineers are expected to bring their own perspective to it.
 



  





**What They're Looking For** 



* Someone with genuine agentic AI depth who can help the team level up how they work, beyond individual productivity into team\-wide workflows
* Someone focused on building agentic capabilities into the product itself, including platforms that allow external agents to consume Devoli's services
* Someone with strong domain experience in telco, ERP, billing, subscription management, logistics, or complex B2B integration environments



  





 You'll have the ability to own a long\-running mission area, operate without a perfectly defined brief, and contribute meaningfully to the platform strategy.
 



  





**What Devoli offers** 



* A technically senior team: 3 of the current 9 engineers are principals
* Real ownership of long\-running missions, not just two\-week stories
* An open, social office environment in a converted historic building in Victoria Park, Auckland
* $50 per week public transport allowance
* Annual Learning \& Development budget of $2,000 fully self\-directed
* Birthday leave
* Friday shared lunches, beer on tap, and a South African braai master who takes the barbecue seriously
* A self\-funded, cash\-generative business with strong board backing and no external funding risk



  





**The kind of person who thrives here** 




 Curious by default. Comfortable with ambiguity. Someone who wants to understand the problem, not just execute the task. Someone who brings strong opinions but holds them loosely, listens well, and cares about the best idea winning rather than being right. Someone who enjoys being around people and engages across the business, not just within their immediate team.
 



  





 Scale\-up and B2B product backgrounds work well. If you are used to owning things end to end, navigating a complex and evolving codebase, and working in an environment where not everything is written down, you will feel at home.

title: Platform Engineer (DevOps)
description:
Build the systems behind the software. Some engineers love building features. Others love understanding how everything works underneath. If you enjoy automation, infrastructure, CI/CD, debugging weird problems, and making systems run better this role might be for you.
   

  

 At Whip Around, our platform powers products used by fleet businesses across the world. We run on AWS, CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and modern engineering workflows that our product teams rely on every day.
   

  

 We're looking for a
 **Platform Engineer (DevOps)** 
 to help us improve the systems that support our engineering teams and products.
   

  

 You might already be in DevOps. Or you might be a software engineer who's always gravitated toward infrastructure, deployment pipelines, automation, or developer tooling. Maybe you're in cloud support and want to move closer to engineering. Maybe you're a full stack engineer who secretly enjoys fixing CI/CD more than shipping UI.
   

  

 If any of that sounds familiar, keep reading.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What you'll actually do**
 You'll work closely with experienced engineers to help keep our environments healthy, deployments smooth, and platform tooling continuously improving.
   

  

 That means things like:
   

  

* Supporting AWS environments across QA, staging and production
* Improving CI/CD pipelines and build processes
* Monitoring systems, troubleshooting issues, and improving reliability
* Helping engineers when environments or deployments aren't behaving
* Contributing to platform improvements across security, performance and cost
* Building confidence working across modern cloud infrastructure and developer tooling


**You'll probably enjoy this role if you:**
 Like understanding how systems work.
   

  

 Enjoy automation.
   

  

 Have a habit of fixing annoying problems.
   

  

 And have some experience or exposure to things like:
   

  

* AWS or cloud computing fundamentals
* CI/CD pipelines or GitHub Actions
* Linux, scripting, terminals or networking fundamentals
* Infrastructure, observability, automation or developer tooling
* Side projects, GitHub repos, Raspberry Pi setups, homelabs, or generally tinkering with technical things


 A note on cloud foundations.
   

  

 This role sits close to the infrastructure that powers our product, so we're looking for people with a solid foundation in cloud computing concepts.
   

  

 That could come from:
   

  

* AWS certifications or coursework
* University papers focused on cloud, distributed systems or infrastructure
* Personal projects using AWS or cloud tooling
* Demonstrable understanding of how modern cloud systems work


 You do not need years of industry experience.
   

  

 In fact, we'd often prefer someone with strong fundamentals and curiosity over someone who's picked up habits without understanding the theory underneath.
   

  

 We use AI heavily in our engineering workflows. Not as a gimmick. As part of how we work every day.
   

  

 You'll learn how we use AI to investigate issues, improve systems, move faster, and become a better engineer — while still understanding what's happening under the hood.
   

  

 If you're excited by the idea of AI helping engineers do better work, you'll probably enjoy it here.
   

  

**Our stack**
 AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS), Docker, CloudFormation, GitLab CI, Datadog, CloudWatch, Sentry, Laravel and React.
   

  

 No, we don't expect you to know all of that on day one.
   

  

**Benefits**
**Why Whip Around?**
 Whip Around is a Kiwi\-founded SaaS company solving real\-world problems at global scale. Recently backed by major investment, we're accelerating the next phase of engineering growth and innovation right here in Auckland.
   

  

 You'll join a team that values ownership, curiosity, continuous improvement, and helping each other succeed.
   

  

 You'll get:
   

  

* Hybrid working with flexibility
* Southern Cross health insurance
* Birthday leave
* Extra paid parental leave
* Monthly team lunches \& regular events
* Free parking
* A team that values growth, ownership and manaakitanga


 If you're looking for a role where you can grow your impact, help shape what's next, and work on meaningful software with good humans — we'd love to chat

**About The Role**
 What if your deep expertise in machine learning could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems think, plan, and make decisions?
   

  

 We're looking for Senior Machine Learning Engineers to work on one of the most intellectually challenging problems in AI right now: teaching large language models how to reason. You'll author high\-fidelity reasoning traces — structured, step\-by\-step records of how an expert approaches and solves complex technical problems — that become the training signal for next\-generation AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for senior technical professionals who thrive on hard problems and want their work to have real, lasting impact on the trajectory of AI.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Author complex, high\-fidelity reasoning traces for sophisticated ML and technical tasks — capturing planning, tool use, and decision\-making in structured formats
* Design and document step\-by\-step problem\-solving strategies that train LLMs to navigate real\-world scenarios reliably
* Review and quality\-check traces to ensure they meet rigorous standards for logical clarity, depth, and usefulness as training data
* Apply senior\-level architectural insight to help AI models develop more robust, reliable reasoning capabilities
* Contribute to data strategies that address the hardest edge cases in model decision\-making


**Who You Are**

**OUR VISION**





 The digital world was built around platforms, not people. AI is rewriting what software can do, and we have a narrow window to make sure that future puts the individual at the center rather than further behind. A future where your digital identity belongs to you, travels with you, and gives you real agency in how you show up online. Where you set the rules, hold the keys, and actually benefit from your own data. We are building toward that future across every layer it requires: the infrastructure that makes it possible, the standards that make it interoperable, and the experiences that bring it to life for the people who use it.
 




**WHAT YOU WILL DO**






 As a Senior AI Engineer at Blockchains, you will be one of the technical decision\-makers for our AI systems layer. You will not just implement solutions; you will recommend the right approach for each problem and help set the standard for how AI works at our company. You will help us figure out what to build, not just how to build it, and you will be prepared to say “this doesn’t need AI” when that’s the honest answer.
   

  













 You will own the AI systems layer end\-to\-end, designing the architecture, setting the standards, and defining the service contracts that front\-end and product engineers build on, while keeping privacy, safety, and cost at the center of every decision.
   

  













 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  










**AI Architecture and Pipeline Design:**



* Architecting context augmentation pipelines: vector RAG, CAG, agentic file exploration, Text\-to\-SQL, knowledge graphs, fine\-tuning, or MCP\-based context engineering, selecting the right approach for each use case.
* Designing chunking strategies, embedding model selection, and retrieval architecture for user\-owned document systems with multi\-tenant isolation.
* Owning data privacy at the systems level: PII handling, GDPR/CCPA compliance, encryption at rest and in transit, and user\-scoped access boundaries.




**LLM Integration and Agent Systems:**


* Integrating and managing LLM APIs (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models) and deploying multi\-agent systems using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph.
* Leading model selection, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), and production evaluation across the AI stack.




**Evaluation and Optimization:**


* Building evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, relevance, and safety, moving beyond vibes\-based testing to systematic, repeatable evals.
* Optimizing AI pipelines for latency, token cost, and throughput; monitoring production systems for drift, degradation, and regressions.
* Defining and implementing feedback loops that connect evals back to iteration, making AI system performance visible and continuously improving in production.




**Infrastructure and Standards:**


* Deploying and operating production AI systems on AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and GitLab.
* Defining AI service contracts and APIs that front\-end and product engineers build on top of.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED**



 You think in systems, not scripts. You have shipped AI in production, you know where pipelines break, and you make architectural decisions that other engineers trust and build on. You exercise strong judgment on when to build versus buy and how to scope an MVP versus a production system, and you understand model selection and cost\-performance tradeoffs: knowing when a smaller fine\-tuned model outperforms a general\-purpose large one, and when expanding the context window beats RAG.
   

  







 You treat AI safety as a first\-class engineering concern, building prompt injection defenses, output filtering, access controls, and data leakage prevention into production AI systems. You use Claude Code or OpenAI Codex as a core part of your development workflow, and you have a track record of mentoring junior engineers and raising the technical bar across a team.
 


**YOUR EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**



 You have at least 2 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems, built on a minimum of 5 years of software engineering experience. Strong Python skills are required, and experience with Node.js or .NET is a plus. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required; demonstrated experience shipping AI products at scale is weighted equally with formal education.
   

  







 You have deep knowledge of LLMs (such as GPT\-4, Claude, Llama, or Mistral), spanning prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and production evaluation, and hands\-on experience designing context augmentation systems: vector RAG (hybrid search, re\-ranking, multi\-tenant isolation), CAG, agentic file exploration, Text\-to\-SQL, knowledge graphs, fine\-tuning, and MCP\-based context engineering. You have a strong command of agent orchestration frameworks, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph, and experience building or using evaluation frameworks to measure LLM output quality, relevance, and safety in production.

 At Corebridge Financial, we believe action is everything. That’s why every day we partner with financial professionals and institutions to make it possible for more people to take action in their financial lives, for today and tomorrow.

* We are stronger as one: We collaborate across the enterprise, scale what works and act decisively for our customers and partners.
* We deliver on commitments: We are accountable, empower each other and go above and beyond for our stakeholders.
* We learn, improve and innovate: We get better each day by challenging the status quo and equipping ourselves for the future.
* We are inclusive: We embrace different perspectives, enabling our colleagues to make an impact and bring their whole selves to work.


**Who You’ll Work With**
 The Information Technology organization is the technological foundation of our business and works in collaboration with our partners from across the company. The team drives technology and digital transformation, partners with business leaders to design and execute new strategies through IT and operations services and ensures the necessary IT risk management and security measures are in place and aligned with enterprise architecture standards and principles.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated AI Engineer with 5\+ years of experience to design, build, and deploy AI solutions, including modern agentic AI workflows. This role will focus on developing scalable ML models and intelligent agents using foundation models to automate complex business processes and enhance decision\-making.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI models for business use cases
* Design and fine\-tune the underlying models, including reasoning chains, tool use, and agent architectures (ReAct, multi\-agent frameworks, etc.)
* Define agent capabilities, scope autonomous decision\-making boundaries, and manage stakeholder expectations around reliability
* Design / optimize prompt instructions, personas, tool descriptions, and reasoning scaffolds that guide agent behavior
* Develop and orchestrate multi\-step AI agents capable of reasoning, tool usage, and workflow execution
* Build agentic workflows leveraging foundation models for task automation and decision support
* Test AI agents against enterprise systems, APIs, tools, and data platforms
* Design benchmarks and automated evaluations to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety across diverse scenarios
* Work with structured and unstructured data for predictive and generative AI solutions
* Manage and mentor a team of Data Scientists, setting clear expectations for model quality, documentation, and production readiness.
* Collaborate with other data scientists, BI teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI\-driven solutions
* Optimize model performance, scalability, and cost efficiency
* Monitor deployed models/agents and implement feedback loops and retraining strategies
* Document technical designs, agent workflows, and system architecture


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
* 4\+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or applied AI engineering
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and evaluation techniques
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and working with large language models (LLMs)
* Experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
* Experience working with APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Familiarity with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Sagemaker and Bedrock for machine learning and generative AI applications
* Familiarity with Bedrock Amazon Guardrails and Knowledge Bases
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon AgentCore for running agentic AI applications
* Experience designing agentic workflows (multi\-agent systems, tool\-using agents, autonomous workflows)
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services
* Knowledge of MLOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, model monitoring)


**Compensation**
 The anticipated salary range for this position is $122,000 to $148,000 at the commencement of employment for the Jersey City, NJ and Woodland Hills, CA area. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. The actual compensation offered will ultimately be dependent on multiple factors, which may include the candidate’s geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications.
   

  

 In addition, the position is eligible for a discretionary bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.
   

  

 Corebridge also offers a range of competitive benefits as part of the total compensation package, as detailed below.
   

  

**Work Location**
 This position is based in Corebridge Financial’s Woodland Hills, CA, Jersey City, NJ, or Houston, TX office and is subject to our hybrid working policy, which gives colleagues the benefits of working both in an office and remotely.
   

  

**Estimated Travel**
 May include up to 25%.
   

  

 Why Corebridge?
   

  

 At Corebridge Financial, we prioritize the health, well\-being, and work\-life balance of our employees. Our comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to support employees both personally and professionally, ensuring that they have the resources and flexibility needed to thrive.
   

  

**Benefit Offerings Include**
* Health and Wellness: We offer a range of medical, dental and vision insurance plans, as well as mental health support and wellness initiatives to promote overall well\-being.
* Retirement Savings: We offer retirement benefits options, which vary by location. In the U.S., our competitive 401(k) Plan offers a generous dollar\-for\-dollar Company matching contribution of up to 6% of eligible pay and a Company contribution equal to 3% of eligible pay (subject to annual IRS limits and Plan terms). These Company contributions vest immediately.
* Employee Assistance Program: Confidential counseling services and resources are available to all employees.
* Matching charitable donations: Corebridge matches donations to tax\-exempt organizations 1:1, up to $5,000\.
* Volunteer Time Off: Employees may use up to 16 volunteer hours annually to support activities that enhance and serve communities where employees live and work.
* Paid Time Off: Eligible employees start off with at least 24 Paid Time Off (PTO) days so they can take time off for themselves and their families when they need it.


 Eligibility for and participation in employer\-sponsored benefit plans and Company programs will be subject to applicable law, governing Plan document(s) and Company policy.
   

  

**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Corebridge Financial, is committed to being an equal opportunity employer and we comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws. All applicants will be considered for employment based on job\-related qualifications and without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, neurodivergence, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. The Company is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. At Corebridge Financial, we believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to building a creative workplace that leads to innovation, growth, and profitability. Through a wide variety of programs and initiatives, we invest in each employee, seeking to ensure that our colleagues are respected as individuals and valued for their unique perspectives.

If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to complete any part of the application or hiring process, please send an email to TalentandInclusion@corebridgefinancial.com. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law.

**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**

 $180K\-$250K \+ Equity

 BUILD, Inc. is a seed\-stage venture creating the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, backed by Index Ventures and c\-suite leaders from OpenAI and Blackstone. Already generating 7\-figure revenue, the team is automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than traditional human processes for trillion\-dollar asset managers.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will own end\-to\-end agentic workflows, from prototype to production, building visual reasoning and multi\-agent systems that solve real\-world problems. Partnering with domain experts and institutional customers, you’ll translate complex real estate tasks into high\-performance software, driving the next generation of automation for the built world’s most significant projects.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Work at the frontier of agentic AI with a team including leadership experience from 11x.ai’s rapid scale\-up and backing from heavyweights like Index Ventures.
* Experience radical autonomy and high\-stakes ownership in a seed\-stage startup that has already achieved 7\-figure revenue and is rapidly approaching 8\-figures.
* Solve hard, unsolved problems where AI meets the physical world, directly impacting massive global infrastructure, energy, and industrial projects through autonomous workflows.


**What You Will Do**
* Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI agents using Python and LangGraph to handle complex, long\-running real estate development workflows.
* Own and ship full\-stack features end\-to\-end, managing everything from backend agent reasoning logic to polished, high\-utility frontend user surfaces.
* Collaborate directly with institutional customers to translate multi\-week manual processes into automated outcomes that scale across trillion\-dollar asset portfolios.


**The ideal candidate**
* Has 3\-5 years of engineering experience, ideally within high\-growth vertical AI companies or elite engineering cultures like Ramp, Scale AI, or Glean.
* Demonstrates a proven track record of shipping production\-grade LLM or agentic systems that deliver measurable value to real\-world end users.
* Possesses full\-stack capabilities with a strong "startup DNA," excelling in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where they can drive projects from concept to completion.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

**Position Summary**
 We're a hospitality company building the next generation of intelligent pricing, demand, and guest\-experience systems. We're hiring an AI Engineer to turn that work into software — models and tools that forecast demand, optimize rates, and surface account intelligence so our revenue managers make sharper decisions, faster.
   

  

 What You'll Build
   

  

* Demand forecasting models that predict occupancy and room\-night demand by property, segment, day\-of\-week, and season — accounting for events, seasonality, and booking pace.
* Dynamic pricing and rate\-optimization engines that recommend BAR and corporate rates, balancing occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR against competitor positioning.
* Account intelligence tooling that ingests internal production data and external signals (M\&A activity, headcount trends, travel\-budget shifts) to flag growing accounts, at\-risk accounts, and uncaptured market opportunity.
* Labor and staffing models that forecast labor demand against projected occupancy and arrivals — optimizing schedules, hours, and cost across housekeeping, front desk, F\&B, and other departments while protecting service levels.
* RFP and negotiation support tools that help the team price contracts, model rate scenarios, and prioritize target accounts during RFP season.
* LLM\-powered workflows — summarizing market intelligence, drafting account strategy notes, and answering natural\-language questions over revenue data.
* A testing laboratory for beta technologies — stand up and run a controlled environment where new AI tools and models can be piloted, stress\-tested, and validated against real operational data before broader rollout, including the experimentation framework, sandboxed data, and feedback loops with property and commercial teams.


 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models on real booking, rate, and market data.
* Build data pipelines that bring together PMS, CRS, booking\-channel, and third\-party market data into clean, reliable feature sets.
* Stand up the infrastructure to serve models in production — APIs, monitoring, retraining, and guardrails.
* Operate the beta testing lab — design pilots, recruit internal users, measure results, and decide what graduates to production versus what gets killed.
* Partner closely with revenue and commercial teams to translate domain knowledge into product, and to make sure outputs are trustworthy and actionable.
* Define and track the metrics that matter — forecast accuracy, recommendation adoption, labor cost and productivity, and downstream revenue impact.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

**Required**
* 3\+ years building and shipping ML systems in production (not just notebooks).
* Strong Python and the modern ML/data stack (e.g. pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, SQL).
* Solid grounding in forecasting, optimization, or recommendation/pricing problems.
* Experience taking models from prototype to deployed service, including monitoring and iteration.
* Ability to communicate clearly with non\-technical stakeholders and translate business problems into technical ones.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in hospitality, travel, airlines, retail, or another revenue\-management\-driven industry.
* Familiarity with dynamic pricing, demand modeling, or yield/revenue management.
* Experience integrating LLMs into applications (RAG, structured extraction, agentic workflows).
* Cloud and MLOps experience (AWS/GCP/Azure, containerization, CI/CD for ML).
* Comfort with experimentation and causal measurement (A/B testing, uplift modeling).


**What We Offer**
* Competitive base salary and performance\-based incentive plan
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing company
* A chance to be part of the Rebel movement redefining hospitality leadership


**Salary Range**
 $190,000 \- $200,000 annually
   

  

**Why This Role**
 You'll own meaningful problems end\-to\-end, see your work move real revenue, and help build a data and AI capability from an early stage. If you want your models to ship and matter rather than sit in a backlog, this is that role.

**What Lumion does** 




 Lumion is the all\-in\-one operating system for trade and technical schools. We power the entire institution: AI\-driven lead generation and conversion, enrollment, financial aid, student lifecycle management, and tuition payments. Most schools are still stitching together five or six disconnected tools to do what our platform handles.
 



  





 America has a massive skilled trades shortage and the schools that train electricians, welders, and nurses are the bottleneck. We're backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 At most companies, AI is a feature added onto an existing product. At Lumion it is the product. Our agents talk with people who are deciding whether to go back to school. They answer questions late on a Sunday night, follow up when a human wouldn't, and carry a prospective student from first question to enrolled.
 



  





 The reliability bar is high because the stakes are. These systems handle money, student records, and regulated communication. They cannot quote the wrong tuition, ignore an opt\-out, or mislead a 19\-year\-old weighing a student loan. Making AI dependable under those conditions is one of the hardest problems in the field right now, and it is the problem you would own.
 



  





**The work** 




 You will own the systems behind Lumion's AI in production.
 



  





**Conversational agents.** 
 AI that talks with people over text, email, and live phone calls: qualifying a lead, answering questions, following up, and handing off to a human at the right moment. You will build the logic that decides when the agent reaches out, what it says, and when it escalates.
 



  





**Retrieval.** 
 Every school is different, so an agent has to answer from that specific school's programs, policies, and pricing rather than a generic guess. You will own the retrieval layer that keeps answers accurate and each customer's data cleanly separated.
 



  





**Multi\-model infrastructure.** 
 Different tasks call for different models. You will own model selection, cost, and latency, using cheaper models where they hold up and the expensive ones only where they pay off.
 



  





**Voice.** 
 Real\-time phone conversations bring their own problems: response timing, interruptions, hold handling, and prompts that survive a caller talking over the agent. Your job is to make these calls hard to distinguish from a person.
 



  





**Reliability.** 
 Evaluations, guardrails, and monitoring. This is the engineering discipline that makes a prototype trustworthy enough to run a school's enrollment pipeline.
 



  





**How we build** 




 You need to be fluent with agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. We care about how you work, not which tool you use. If your AI experience stops at pasting prompts into ChatGPT, this is not the right role. The tools also do not replace judgment. You need to recognize when the output is wrong, and when a quick fix will cost you later.
 



 This is product engineering. You ship to customers and iterate fast, and whatever you build has to hold up in production from day one.
 



  





 This is an in\-office role in South Jordan, Utah, by design. Hard problems get solved faster in person, and we want whoever owns our AI working directly alongside the team and the CTO.
 



  





**Who you are** 



* **You have shipped production AI.** 
 Real systems that users relied on, where you dealt with hallucination, runaway costs, latency limits, and the failures that only show up at scale.
* **You have strong fundamentals.** 
 Data modeling, API design, system architecture, and the ability to debug a production incident under pressure. The AI sits on top of a serious platform, so you need to be solid on both.
* **You have product sense.** 
 You understand why a requirement exists, not only how to build it. That matters most when money, student data, and compliance are involved.
* **You're sharp, not credentialed.** 
 Your degree and years of experience don't matter to us. What you can build and how fast you learn do.



  





**Why you'll want this** 



* **Ownership.** 
 You will own Lumion's entire AI surface. At a larger company you might own a single prompt and wait weeks to ship. Here you own the agents, retrieval, voice, and reliability, and you ship constantly.
* **Equity.** 
 Your stock is tied to revenue that is growing, so what you build connects directly to what your equity is worth.
* **Impact.** 
 The people on the other end of this software go on to become electricians, nurses, and welders. The work matters, and you will feel it.
* **Speed.** 
 Strong product direction, an AI\-native engineering culture, and the autonomy to move quickly without layers of process.



  





**Comp and benefits** 



* Salary based on what you can do
* Meaningful stock options
* Bonuses tied to company revenue
* MacBook Pro and the AI tooling you need
* Unlimited PTO
* 401(k)
* Health, dental, and vision reimbursement up to $537\.50/mo
* $200/mo tech stipend
* $100/mo wellness stipend



  





*Must be authorized to work in the US. We do not sponsor work visas. This is an in\-office role in South Jordan, Utah, and relocation support is available for the right person.* 




  





**How to apply** 




 Skip the cover letter. Send us the best AI system you have shipped, what it did in production, and what went wrong along the way. We will get into the prompt engineering and system design when we talk.

description:
**Join nesto** — proudly named Canadian Rocketship 2025\*. A Deloitte Fast 50 company evolving alongside Canada’s top tech innovators and disrupting a 2\.1 Trillion\-dollar mortgage industry at light speed by building the mortgage ecosystem of the future.

 **BUILD** lending technology with the best developers, AI engineers, and mortgage experts in the country. Work on a modern tech stack and a development framework designed to **unlock your full potential** and accelerate your career.

 **Why join us**

* Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 years in a row
* Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025\*
* Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 consecutive years
* Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
* Trusted technology: powering major financial institutions across Canada
* An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients.

 **WHO ARE YOU**


Builders. Problem\-solvers. Curious minds. People who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together.


If you trust your skills and want to build real technology that reshapes an entire industry, join us now.

 **ABOUT NESTO AND NESTO CLOUD**


Canada's leading mortgage technology company.


Nesto is Canada’s leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing $73B\+ CAD in residential and commercial mortgages, with 1,000\+ team members across 12 offices nationwide. You will be working on Nesto Cloud, Canada’s most advanced cloud platform, delivering end\-to\-end technology solutions for lenders in the digital age.

 **ABOUT THE TEAM**

**Where you sit.**


You'll be joining the Origination stream, the product area responsible for the end\-to\-end mortgage journey, covering self\-serve and advisor\-supported application flows, underwriting, decisioning, and funding.


This is a Senior PM role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own your specific substream within origination. You'll work closely with the stream lead, and together you'll define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team's needs, and where the biggest opportunities are. It's a rare chance to have real influence over your own scope from day one.


Your closest collaborators will be engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, mortgage operations and underwriting experts who live inside these processes daily, and the brokers and advisors who depend on these tools to serve clients.

 **WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Act as one of the primary origination subject\-matter experts for your substream, deeply understanding end\-to\-end origination processes, regulatory requirements, and operational realities.
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real\-world origination requirements, operational efficiencies, and compliance considerations.
* Identify and assess the impact of new lending features, regulatory changes, and origination workflow evolutions to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, and compliance to validate designs and proposed solutions, ensuring they align with origination best practices and industry standards.
* Support the backlog refinement process by prioritizing origination\-related epics and stories, balancing customer experience, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
* Participate in release planning, UAT, and pre\-launch readiness to ensure origination use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
* Conduct research on industry trends, evolving regulations, origination technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights to guide product evolution.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation of origination processes, scenarios, requirements, and system behaviours to support product teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Act as the go\-to expert for your origination workflows, answering questions, supporting issue triage, and ensuring the product supports exceptional origination experiences across all lending products.

 **AI\-Augmented Ways of Working**

* Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others) to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery: synthesizing research, prototyping ideas, and measuring results.
* Don't wait for a perfect process to test a hypothesis. Use the tools available to you to get to answers faster, whether that means building a rough prototype, running a quick experiment, or drafting a solution to pressure\-test with users before it becomes a roadmap item.
* Comfortable going beyond traditional PM boundaries when the situation calls for it, the best people here don't hand off and wait, they stay close to the work and use every tool at their disposal to move it forward.
* Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap.
* Share what you discover. How you work should make the people around you better.

 **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**The profile.**

* 5\-7\+ years of hands\-on experience in product management, ideally with exposure to mortgage origination, lending, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
* Understanding of end\-to\-end origination functions from application flows, document collection, underwriting, credit decisioning to compliance checkpoints, and funding processes.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance requirements, and reporting obligations.
* Experience working with origination platforms, LOS systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into functional system requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, and QA teams.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills with an ability to anticipate downstream impacts and foresee edge cases in origination workflows.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex origination concepts clearly to non\-experts in Product and Engineering.
* Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow : discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

 **PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST**

* Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
* Familiarity with broker and advisor\-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self\-serve client journeys.
* Exposure to AI or ML\-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context.

 **YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF**  

**Be honest with yourself.**

* You're only comfortable in a well\-defined product area. This role requires you to help shape your own scope: ambiguity is the starting condition, not an exception.
* You treat AI tools as a curiosity rather than a daily accelerant.
* You hand off a PRD and consider your job done. Ownership here runs from discovery all the way through to measuring results in production.
* You don't thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
* You are not open to experimentation and continuous improvement.

 **INTERVIEW PROCESS**

**How we get to know each other.**

* Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
* Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
* Take\-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q\&A – 60 minutes
* Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
* Criminal Record and Reference Checks \+ Offer

 **THE REWARD**

title: AI Engineer/ Anthropic Architect (FDE)
description:
Join a company that’s leading the way in AI and automation consulting. Our portfolio spans 10\+ leading technologies across business applications, data, process, cloud, and AI. At Bits In Glass, you’ll do meaningful work with a supportive, driven team that loves to collaborate and celebrate wins together. Whether you’re coding, consulting, or bringing bold ideas to the table, you’ll tackle real business challenges, grow your skills, and make a BIG impact.

  

Our growing team has earned global recognition as a Great Place to Work and received multiple industry partner awards—while keeping things fun and people\-focused. If you’re looking to deepen your expertise and solve real\-world problems, Bits In Glass could be the place for you.

  

BIG is looking for a high\-impact AI practitioner to join our rapidly growing Anthropic practice. This is a hybrid role that spans three critical functions — AI Engineering, Applied AI Architecture, and Forward Deployed Engineering — making it ideal for a versatile technologist who thrives at the intersection of deep technical delivery and enterprise customer engagement.



You will serve as a technical SME on Anthropic's Claude ecosystem: designing enterprise AI architectures, embedding directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications, and acting as a trusted pre\-sales advisor helping organizations unlock the full potential of frontier AI. This role is for someone who moves fast, operates with high autonomy, and is energized by building real things that create measurable business value.

  



Roles and Responsibilities :

* Embed directly with BIG's most strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and ship production AI applications powered by Claude


* Deliver technical artifacts including MCP servers, sub\-agents, agent skills, and evaluation frameworks used in real customer workflows


* Lead rapid prototyping and proof\-of\-concept engagements that demonstrate tangible business impact from day one


* Act as the primary technical contact on\-site, coordinating across BIG delivery, sales, and Anthropic partner teams


* Design scalable, enterprise\-grade AI architectures leveraging Claude API, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise


* Advise customers on agentic workflow design, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, evaluation frameworks, and LLM deployment at scale


* Translate complex customer requirements into architecture blueprints and technical roadmaps that align with business goals


* Identify and mitigate technical risks early in engagements to set delivery teams up for success


* Guide integration of Anthropic solutions with cloud hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise data stacks


* Partner with Account Executives throughout the sales lifecycle to develop winning technical strategies for Anthropic\- powered solutions


* Lead technical discovery workshops to uncover customer business objectives, current\-state architecture, and AI readiness


* Build and deliver compelling demos, prototypes, and POCs that showcase Claude's capabilities for specific customer use cases


* Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires with clear, accurate, and persuasive technical content


* Translate complex AI concepts into business value for both technical teams and executive stakeholders


* Serve as an internal expert on the Anthropic Claude ecosystem — enabling the broader team through knowledge sharing and documentation


* Contribute reusable demo assets, accelerators, architecture playbooks, and prompt engineering guides


* Represent BIG at customer events, webinars, and Anthropic partner activities


* Provide structured field feedback to Anthropic product and partner teams to help shape roadmap direction

  

 Required Experience:


* 5\+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a customer\-facing AI role


* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building production applications with LLMs — specifically Claude, GPT\-4, or equivalent enterprise models


* Demonstrated experience with advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and LLM deployment at scale


* Strong Python skills; proficiency in TypeScript, Java, or another secondary language is a plus


* Experience building or designing agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or DSPy


* Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP


* Proven ability to conduct technical discovery with enterprise customers and translate requirements into architecture decisions


* Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can make complex AI topics clear and compelling to both engineers and executives


* High agency, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to operate autonomously in customer environments

  

 Nice to have:


* Hands\-on experience with Anthropic's Claude API, Claude Code, MCP servers, or Claude for Enterprise


* Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), and document processing pipelines


* Experience with evaluation and observability tooling for LLMs (LangSmith, Braintrust, Weights \& Biases, MLflow)


* Background in enterprise sales cycles, deal structuring, or professional services delivery


* Anthropic, AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications relevant to AI/ML workloads


* Degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field

  



Why BIG?


* Work on meaningful, high\-impact AI projects for enterprise clients across Canada, the US, the UK, and India — at the frontier of what's possible with Claude


* Join a Certified Great Place to Work with a people\-first, collaborative culture that celebrates wins together


* Access to 10\+ cutting\-edge technology practices and a culture of continuous learning and certification support


* Competitive compensation, benefits, and equity\-aligned incentives


* Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment with a team that moves fast and builds real things

description:

Calgary \- 4906 Richard Road SW
**Business**

At Brookfield Residential, a leading North American land developer and homebuilder for over 65 years, we have had one goal in mind – creating the best places to call home. From the development of award\-winning, master\-planned communities to the creation of well\-designed homes, we are committed to cultivating exceptional life experiences for our customers, partners, employees, and members of the community.
  

  

As part of Brookfield — one of the largest alternative asset managers in the world — we harness our resources to bring a fresh approach, unparalleled creativity, relentless innovation, and sound Sustainability practices to the planning, development, and management of buildings everywhere. From offices, retail spaces, and logistics facilities to multifamily residences, hospitality establishments, and mixed\-use structures — we are reimagining real estate from the ground up.


If you're ready to be a part of our team, we encourage you to apply.


**Job Description**

**Overview:**

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer for a 3\-to\-6\-month contract to maintain continuity and momentum across enterprise AI initiatives during a planned leave period (sxisting vacancy).


In this role, you will serve as the senior technical lead and AI solution development advisor for Brookfield Residential's AI program. Your responsibilities will include building solutions, development, targeted delivery support, and governance input across Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, M365 Copilot, Azure AI services, and related AI\-enabled automation.


This role is uniquely positioned to blend building, development, delivery, governance, and continuity support. You will translate complex business needs into scalable and supportable AI solutions, ensuring alignment with Brookfield’s enterprise guardrails. You will also collaborate closely with internal teams and vendors and support a seamless knowledge transfer at the end of the engagement.  

  



**Key Responsibilities:**

* Act as the senior AI Engineer and technical lead for ongoing AI initiatives. Translate business requirements into solution builds spanning Copilot Studio agents, AI\-enabled Power Automate workflows, Azure OpenAI / Azure AI services, and broader Power Platform solutions. Recommend architectural decisions, development patterns, security considerations, and integration approaches before development begins.
* Support and guide steady\-state delivery, improvement, troubleshooting, and optimization of Copilot Studio agents, with hands\-on contribution where required. This may include AI Navigator, Bid Package Manager, myIT Assist, and similar internal use cases as priorities require. Maintain supporting Power Automate flows, Dataverse models, connectors, Teams/SharePoint integrations, and agent\-related assets. Coordinate delivery priorities with the AI Huddle and internal owners.
* Provide technical feasibility, guardrail, and integration input to Product \& Engineering leadership, IT collaborators, and the AI Accelerator Council / Technology Task Force. Support AI governance activities including 3\-Zone DLP considerations for AI connectors, citizen\-AI guardrails, emerging AI tool evaluations / POCs, responsible AI considerations, and Application Insights telemetry for Copilot Studio agents.

* Support M365 Copilot pilot and early\-adopter activities by offering technical feasibility and integration mentorship regarding M365 Copilot use cases, deployment and licensing questions, and custom Copilot agents/extensions across Teams and SharePoint. Serve as a technical advisor for M365 Copilot usage and extensibility questions.
* Provide targeted advisory and support for AI\-adjacent Power Platform and Azure integration workflows, including Power Automate cloud/desktop flows, Dataverse, Power Apps, Azure Logic Apps, app registrations, Key Vault, Application Insights, and related services where they connect to the AI program or address critical issues in business automation needs.
* Maintain clear user documentation, solution diagrams, architecture artifacts, environment notes, runbooks, support paths, and design\-decision records. Complete a structured knowledge transfer and handoff to designated internal owners before contract completion.

* 10\+ years of experience crafting and developing systems using programming concepts (Object\-Oriented Design \& Development).
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in building and developing AI solutions, delivering enterprise\-grade AI, automation, cloud, or Microsoft platform solutions, translating business requirements into scalable solutions.
* Deep familiarity with enterprise AI solution patterns, including LLM\-enabled workflows, AI agents, governance, and integration with business systems.
* A solid understanding of the Microsoft AI stack is highly preferred, including Copilot Studio, Power Platform, M365 Copilot, and Azure AI services.
* Solid ability to bridge technical execution and business strategy.
* Comfortable operating independently in a contract / interim role with limited ramp\-up time.
* Experience working in real estate, construction, corporate IT, internal application teams, or enterprise shared services is an asset.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in AI, cloud architecture, Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, or solution architecture are an asset.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical collaborators.
* Strong architectural judgment, especially around security, supportability, maintainability, and business risk.
* Practical, delivery\-oriented approach with the ability to prioritize urgent operational needs, advisory requests, and work that can be deferred.
* Strong documentation and knowledge transferring the field.

**What We Offer:**

* Hybrid / Remote flexibility for this role. Calgary\-based candidates are preferred for occasional in\-person collaboration.
* A culture based on our values of Passion, Integrity and Community!

description:
WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology\-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.


WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies’ own omni\-channel patient services offerings.


WELL owns and operates Canada's largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi\-national multi\-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "WELL".


To learn more about the company, please visit: www.well.company.

**The opportunity**


Reporting to the Finance Data \& AI Lead, the Applied AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI\-powered solutions that create measurable business value across the organization.


This is a hands\-on role focused on applying AI to real business challenges, not building foundation models. Working closely with business, data, and technology teams, you will take AI solutions from concept to production, delivering agents, assistants, automations, and applications that help teams work smarter and make better decisions.


You are a builder who enjoys solving complex problems, navigating ambiguity, and creating enterprise\-ready solutions that people actually use. Joining WELL's growing Business Transformation team, you will help shape the future of AI across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations.

*This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with a preference for candidates located in Toronto or Vancouver.*

**Who you are**


You are a builder who gets energized by turning ideas into solutions that people actually use. Whether starting with a whiteboard sketch, a business challenge, or an emerging opportunity, you enjoy taking ownership of the entire journey, from design and development through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.


You combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity, creativity, and business acumen. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and enjoy working closely with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to achieve before determining the best technical path forward. While AI is your toolkit, your focus is always on solving real business problems and creating measurable value.


You thrive in environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity exists, and innovation is encouraged. Rather than waiting for perfect requirements, you are comfortable navigating complexity, connecting the dots, and building practical solutions that improve efficiency, support decision\-making, and automate workflows.


Most importantly, you understand that successful AI solutions require more than great prompts. They require thoughtful integration, secure access to data, testing, monitoring, governance, and ongoing iteration. You have experience delivering solutions into production environments and understand what it takes to build systems that are reliable, scalable, and trusted by users.

**What's in it for you**

*Build what’s next.* This is an opportunity to help shape how AI is applied across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations. You will join a growing team that is building enterprise AI capabilities from the ground up, giving you the chance to contribute to high\-impact initiatives and influence how the organization leverages AI in the years ahead.

*Make an impact.* You will have the opportunity to build solutions that are adopted across the business and create meaningful outcomes for teams and stakeholders. Unlike many AI roles that focus primarily on experimentation, this role offers the chance to see your work move into production, gain adoption, and deliver measurable impact.

*Grow with the team.* You will work alongside experienced AI, data, and technology leaders while gaining exposure to enterprise\-scale AI implementation across a variety of business functions. As WELL continues to expand its AI capabilities, there will be opportunities to grow your expertise, take on increasingly complex initiatives, and help shape the future direction of the team.

**You will:**

* **Build AI solutions.** You will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI\-powered solutions that help teams work smarter and make better decisions. Working closely with business stakeholders, data teams, and technology partners, you will translate business needs into practical applications, intelligent agents, assistants, workflow automations, and other AI\-enabled solutions.
* **Connect data and systems.** You will connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, systems, APIs, and business applications, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards. You will partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to establish reliable data access patterns and support long\-term maintainability.
* **Optimize performance.** As solutions move into production, you will be responsible for evaluating performance, monitoring effectiveness, implementing appropriate controls and guardrails, and continuously improving outcomes based on user feedback and business results.
* **Evaluate and Improve AI Performance.** You will design testing and evaluation approaches to measure solution quality, accuracy, reliability, and business effectiveness. You will monitor production AI solutions and continuously improve performance based on user feedback and operational metrics. An important part of this role is the ability to implement guardrails, access controls, and monitoring to support responsible AI use.
* **Drive adoption.** Along the way, you will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities, demonstrate solutions, educate users, and help drive the successful adoption of AI technologies.

**Here's what you bring:**

* **Technical foundation.** You have 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, data engineering, automation, or related technical roles. You have experience designing, building, and deploying production software and AI solutions and understand the realities of supporting those solutions after launch. You have strong programming skills in Python and experience with API, databases, cloud environments, and enterprise integrations to connect systems, data, and AI capabilities to solve business challenges.
* **AI expertise.** You have worked with modern large language model platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar technologies. You understand, build, deploy, and deliver on AI application concepts such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and agent\-based architectures.
* **Delivery mindset.** Beyond the technical skills, you bring a strong delivery mindset. You enjoy taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and moving solutions from concept to production. You understand how to balance innovation with practicality and are motivated by building solutions that create meaningful business outcomes.
* **Stakeholder partnership.** You communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and enjoy collaborating with others to understand business challenges, align priorities, and translate needs into practical technical solutions.
* **Curiosity and continuous learning.** You are naturally curious, eager to learn, and energized by solving complex problems. You think beyond immediate requirements, consider long\-term scalability, and are always looking for better ways to create value through technology.

**Preferred qualifications**


While not required, experience building AI assistants, agents, workflow automations, enterprise search, or knowledge management solutions would be an asset. Additional experience with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and AI orchestration and automation tooling such as LangGraph, n8n, or Logic Apps, as well as AI monitoring, evaluation, and observability practices, would help you ramp up quickly. Experience working in healthcare, regulated industries, or privacy\-sensitive environments is also considered an asset.

**Why join us?**


Healthcare is our sector, and we know that for WELL to be a winning team, we must provide an open environment to prioritize health and wellbeing and multiple resources to discuss mental, physical, and psychological needs openly. From the CEO to the newest hire, everyone comes together as part of our culture of respect, openness, support, and communication. We unite to empower each other to be the best we can be.


We recognize that the best way to serve our diverse patient communities is by reflecting that diversity. With almost 65% of our team members identifying as female and 70% of our leadership identifying as a visible minority, we are proud of our diverse, equitable and inclusive organization.

**Apply now**


Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELL, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role and your experience.
* A 45\-minute virtual technical interview with a Senior AI Engineer to discuss your technical experience, AI solution delivery, and approach to building enterprise\-ready applications.
* A final virtual interview with the Finance Data \& AI Lead and VP, Business Transformation to discuss business impact, collaboration, and alignment with WELL's vision for AI.

**Compensation**


The salary range for this position is $140K\- 150K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.


WELL is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success – this is the WELL Way.


WELL has been independently certified as a Great Place to Work® by the Great Place to Work Institute® Canada. This recognition reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture rooted in trust, inclusivity, and employee well\-being. It also aligns with our Healthy Place to Work pillar and the priorities outlined in our annual Sustainability Impact Report.


Read more about us: https://stories.well.company/

title: (Senior) Applied ML Researcher
description:
#### **Wir suchen dich**

Wir sind ein erfolgreiches, inhabergeführtes und eigenfinanziertes SaaS\-Unternehmen mit einem schönen Campus im Düsseldorfer Medienhafen. Seit 2004 bauen wir Telefonielösungen, inzwischen mit knapp 260 Kolleg:innen, und arbeiten dabei crossfunktional, selbstorganisiert, immer fair und auf Augenhöhe.  

  

Für uns ist KI nicht nur ein Schlagwort oder der nächste große Hype. Es ist die beste Option, die Telefonie unserer Kund:innen – und damit ihren gesamten Arbeitsalltag – effizienter und intuitiver zu gestalten.

  

Was uns dafür fehlt, ist ein:e **Applied ML Researcher**, die:der wissenschaftliche Methodik direkt in unsere praxisnahe R\&D\-Arbeit rund um Sprachmodelle und Conversational AI einbringt. Du operationalisierst offene Fragestellungen sauber, baust Experimente auf, evaluierst sie – und setzt vieles davon auch selbst um. Idealerweise bringst du einen linguistischen Hintergrund mit und denkst gleichermaßen in Hypothesen wie in echten Anwendungsfällen.

#### **Das machen wir und darum brauchen wir dich**


Als Applied ML Researcher entwickelst du forschungsnahe Problemlösungen, die unsere ML\- und AI\-Engineers in der Produktentwicklung aufgreifen. Du bringst wissenschaftliche Methoden direkt in die Praxis, mit dem Ziel, unsere KI\-Produkte messbar besser und robuster zu machen.

* Teamaufbau mitgestalten: Du wirkst aktiv am konzeptionellen und organisatorischen Aufbau unseres ML\-Research\-Teams mit und etablierst gemeinsam mit uns Forschungs\-, Evaluations\- und Transferprozesse.
* Probleme operationalisieren: Du übersetzt offene Problemstellungen in saubere Hypothesen und überprüfbare Fragestellungen und wählst die passenden wissenschaftlichen Methoden, um sie zu beantworten.
* Experimente konzipieren und umsetzen: Du entwirfst Experimente inklusive der dafür nötigen Grundvoraussetzungen (Daten, Baselines, Metriken, Setups) und überführst deine Ideen eigenständig in lauffähige Proof of Concepts.
* Modelle optimieren und evaluieren: Du optimierst LLMs mit Techniken wie SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, Preference Learning und Reward Modellierung und entwickelst Ansätze zur Steigerung von Leistungsfähigkeit, Fairness und Robustheit – gerade in mehrsprachigen und sensiblen Anwendungsdomänen.
* LLM\-Systeme konzipieren: Du entwickelst prototypisch LLM\-basierte Systeme entlang definierter Vorgehensmodelle.
* Diskurs \& Transfer: Du hast aktuelle Entwicklungen und Erkenntnisse immer im Blick, nimmst an Konferenzen und Fachcommunities teil und kommunizierst dein Wissen gut aufbereitet an deine (Team\-) Kolleg:innen.

#### **So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag bei sipgate aus:**

* **Research meets Product:** Du übersetzt wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in mögliche Produktverbesserungen und kannst klare, evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen aussprechen.
* **Experimentieren \& Evaluieren:** Du entwirfst Experimente samt der nötigen Grundvoraussetzungen, operationalisierst die entsprechenden Prozessziele, analysierst und evaluierst die Ergebnisse.
* **Hands\-on umsetzen:** Du bringst das Wissen und Skills mit, um deine Ideen selbst umzusetzen und Proof of Concepts zu bauen.
* **Lernen \& Wachsen:** Du teilst dein Wissen im Team und in der gesamten Firma.

#### **Das bringst du mit:**

**Must\-haves**

  

* Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen KI\-Problemstellungen, mit Schwerpunkt in Bereichen wie fortgeschrittenen Lernparadigmen (Self\-supervised Learning, Weak Supervision, Active Learning, etc.), NLP, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, etc.
* Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche Methoden auf neue Problemstellungen anzuwenden.
* Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Prompt Engineering und solides Verständnis moderner Trainings\- und Inferenzpipelines.
* Solides Verständnis von End\-to\-End\-ML\-Systemen: von Datenvorverarbeitung über Training und Inferenz bis zu Monitoring und Evaluation, auch in Cloud\-basierten Infrastrukturen.
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, marktüblichen Machine Learning Frameworks und mindestens einem Deep\-Learning\-Framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc.).
* Fundiertes Verständnis von Evaluationsmethoden für LLM\-Systeme.
* Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1\).
* Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, mind. 1x pro Monat mit uns in Düsseldorf zusammenzuarbeiten.

**Nice\-to\-have*** Erfahrung mit Audiomodellen, Speech\-to\-Text \& Text\-to\-Speech sowie Conversational AI.
* Erfahrung mit LangChain, LangGraph oder ähnlichen Frameworks.
* Cloud\-basierte ML\-Infrastrukturen / MLOps.
* Publikationen auf einschlägigen Konferenzen.

* Wir haben flache Hierarchien und Peer\-Verantwortung ist unser Credo – das bedeutet: Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Entscheidungen treffen und aufeinander acht geben stehen hoch im Kurs.

 AI has nailed objective domains and can generate anything. The hard part left is judgement: what fits, what feels like you, what's actually GREAT. We're turning that into something measurable, starting with design.
 



  





 We do it on two sides: building the post\-training data and RL environments that teach taste to frontier models, and the context and verification tools agents need to produce work that's more creative, more on\-brand, more right.

* Craft agent harnesses, memory and self\-improvement loops
* Design evaluation pipelines and synthetic data generation
* Eval design and grading of unverifiable domains
* Create embedding and retrieval infrastructure that scales to millions of requests

* Set up inference serving and APIs for client\-facing products
